column1: msgA-DataScramblingIndexIdentifier used to initiate data scrambling (c_init) for msgA PUSCH. If the field is absent the UE applies the value Physical cell ID (physCellID).
msgA-DeltaPreamblePower offset of msgA PUSCH relative to the preamble received target power. Actual value = field value * 2 [dB] (see TS 38.213 [13], clause 7.1).

msgA-PUSCH-ResourceGroupAMsgA PUSCH resources that the UE shall use when performing MsgA transmission using preambles group A. If field is not configured for the selected UL BWP, the UE shall use the MsgA PUSCH configuration for group A of initial UL BWP or RedCap-specific initial UL BWP (if configured) for (e)RedCap UEs.
msgA-PUSCH-ResourceGroupBMsgA PUSCH resources that the UE shall use when performing MsgA transmission using preambles group B.

msgA-TransformPrecoderEnables or disables the transform precoder for MsgA transmission (see clause 6.1.3 of TS 38.214 [19]). If the field is absent in MsgA-ConfigCommon which is configured directly within a BWP (i.e., not within AdditionalRACH-Config), the UE determines whether to enable the transform precoding according to the msg3-transformPrecoder in RACH-ConfigCommon in the configured BWP. If the field is absent in MsgA-ConfigCommon in AdditionalRACH-Config, the UE determines whether to enable the transform precoding according to the msg3-transformPrecoder in RACH-ConfigCommon in the same AdditionalRACH-Config.
